risk_if_not_implemented: Without Physically Secure All Media Containing Sensitive / Regulated Data, unauthorized individuals may gain physical access to facilities and equipment, enabling theft, tampering, damage or safety incidents. Based on the risk and threat mapping for this control, this deficiency most likely exposes the organization to Unauthorized Access (R-AC-4), Loss, Theft or Damage of Assets (R-AM-1), System / Data Compromise (Non-Technical Vector) (R-BC-5), Loss of Confidentiality (R-IP-2), and most likely increases susceptibility to natural threats NT-2, NT-3, NT-4, NT-5, NT-6, NT-8, NT-11, NT-12, NT-13, NT-14; Physical Crime (MT-5), Human Error (MT-9).

compensating_control_1.name: Encrypting Data At Rest
compensating_control_1.description: Cryptographic mechanisms exist to prevent the unauthorized disclosure of data at rest.
compensating_control_1.justification: Encrypting Data At Rest (CRY-07) provides cryptographic protection that compensates for the absence of Physically Secure All Media (DCH-14) by ensuring data confidentiality and integrity through alternative technical means. Given the data-handling focus of this control, this compensating control targets the same underlying risk objective through an alternative approach, helping to maintain an acceptable level of residual risk until the primary control can be implemented.

compensating_control_2.name: Physical Access Control
compensating_control_2.description: Physical access control mechanisms exist to enforce physical access authorizations for all physical access points (including designated entry/exit points) to facilities (excluding those areas within the facility officially designated as publicly accessible).
compensating_control_2.justification: Physical Access Control (PES-08) provides access control enforcement that compensates for the absence of Physically Secure All Media (DCH-14) by restricting system and data access to authorized users through alternative identity and access mechanisms. Given the data-handling focus of this control, this compensating control targets the same underlying risk objective through an alternative approach, helping to maintain an acceptable level of residual risk until the primary control can be implemented.
